name: admin.apps.config.set
purpose: Set the app config for a connector

app_id.desc: The encoded app ID to set the app config for.

workflow_auth_strategy.desc: The workflow auth permission. Can be one of builder_choice or end_user_only.

rich_link_preview_type.desc: Indicates the app-level override for rich link preview. Unsupported for free teams.

domain_restrictions.desc: Domain restrictions for the app. Should be an object with two properties: urls and emails. Each is an array of strings, and each sets the allowed URLs and emails for connector authorization, respectively.
